title: CobbleMelon Modpack
description: This modpack is for the server CobbleMelon!
body:
Welcome to cobblemelon! This is a modpack made for the server CobbleMelon.

CobbleMelon is a cobblemon modpack with raids, gyms, trainers and more!

This is only needed client sided because CobbleMelon already has these mods.

_**If you would like to join the server join our discord!**_

**https://discord.gg/dBUgeajNym**
